verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented way for a user to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking in Gram or its CLI. The only related item is the ability to 'configure telemetry delivery' via the platform MCP. That is an adjacent observability-export control for the governed tool-call data, not a privacy opt-out. Most other evidence describes the product tracking usage, such as tool logs, audit records and spend tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
